scenario: Workplace collaboration on a new software feature

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Hey Bob, can you look at the new feature design?

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Yes, I can look at it. Where is the documentation located?

interview.question: How did the interaction go?
interview.answer: It was fine, but Bob asked for documentation immediately.

turns.speaker: Charlie
turns.text: Let's grab lunch at that new loud trendy place downtown!

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: Loud environments are overwhelming for me. Could we go somewhere quieter or order in?

turns.speaker: Frank
turns.text: How do you feel about the current project pacing?

turns.speaker: Eve
turns.text: [Types on AAC device] Too fast. Need more time per task.
